        function getParam(p) {
            var match = RegExp('[?&]' + p + '=([^&]*)').exec(window.location.search);
            return match && decodeURIComponent(match[1].replace(/\+/g, ' '));
        }

        function getExpiryRecord(value) {
            var expiryPeriod = 90 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000; // 90 days in ms
            return {
                value: value,
                expiryDate: new Date().getTime() + expiryPeriod
            };
        }

        const params = ['gclid', 'fbclid', 'msclkid'];
        let didStore = false;

        params.forEach(function(param) {

                const record = getExpiryRecord(value);
                localStorage.setItem(param + '_record', JSON.stringify(record));

<script type="text/rocketlazyloadscript">
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
        const utilityOpenBtns = document.querySelectorAll('.js-mobileUtilityOpen, .js-mobileLanguageTrigger');
        const utilityCloseBtns = document.querySelectorAll('.js-mobileUtilityClose');
        // const utilityBackBtns = document.querySelectorAll('.js-mobileUtilityBack');
        const utilityOverlays = document.querySelectorAll('.mobile-utility-overlay');

        function closeAllUtilityOverlays() {
            utilityOverlays.forEach(panel => {
                panel.classList.add('u-hidden');
                panel.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
            });
        }

        utilityOpenBtns.forEach(btn => {
            btn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
                e.preventDefault();

                const targetId = btn.getAttribute('data-target');
                const target = document.getElementById(targetId);

                if (!target) return;

                closeAllUtilityOverlays();
                target.classList.remove('u-hidden');
                target.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
            });
        });

        utilityCloseBtns.forEach(btn => {
            btn.addEventListener('click', closeAllUtilityOverlays);
        });

        const pb_closeBtn = document.getElementById('close_promo_banner');
        const pb_banner   = document.getElementById('global-promo-banner');
        const pb_spacer   = document.getElementById('global-nav-spacer');
        const globalNav = document.getElementById('globalNav');

        if (!pb_closeBtn) return;
        
        function closePb() {
            if (pb_banner) {
                pb_banner.classList.add('u-hidden');
                globalNav.style.marginBottom = 0;
            }

            if (pb_spacer) {
                pb_spacer.style.minHeight = '80px';
            }

            const hpHeroContent = document.getElementById('hp_hero_content');

            if (hpHeroContent) {
                hpHeroContent.classList.remove('u-md-pt6');
                hpHeroContent.classList.add('u-md-pt2');
            }
        }

        pb_closeBtn.addEventListener('click', closePb);
        
        const scrollStart = window.scrollY

        window.addEventListener("scroll", function closeOnScroll() {
            let currentPosition = window.scrollY - scrollStart
            // console.log(currentPosition)
            if (currentPosition > 150) {
                closePb()
                window.removeEventListener("scroll", closeOnScroll, false)
            }
        })
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('.js-mobileToggle').forEach(btn => {
        btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
            const panelId = btn.getAttribute('aria-controls');
            const panel = document.getElementById(panelId);

            const isOpen = btn.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true';

            // toggle aria
            btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', !isOpen);

            // toggle panel
            panel.classList.toggle('u-hidden');

            btn.classList.toggle('is-open', !isOpen);
        });
    });
    function closeAllAccordions() {
        document.querySelectorAll('.js-mobileToggle').forEach(btn => {
            const panelId = btn.getAttribute('aria-controls');
            const panel = document.getElementById(panelId);

            btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
            btn.classList.remove('is-open'); // 👈 add this

            if (panel) {
                panel.classList.add('u-hidden');
            }
        });
    }
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
        const openBtn = document.querySelector('.js-mobileHamburger');
        const closeBtn = document.querySelector('.js-mobileHamburgerClose');
        const mobileMenu = document.querySelector('.mobile-primary-nav');

        if (!openBtn || !closeBtn || !mobileMenu) return;

        function openMenu() {
            mobileMenu.classList.add('is-open');
            mobileMenu.classList.remove('u-hidden');

            openBtn.classList.add('u-hiddenVisually');
            closeBtn.classList.remove('u-hiddenVisually');

            document.body.classList.add('mobile-nav-open');
        }

        function closeMenu() {
            mobileMenu.classList.remove('is-open');
            mobileMenu.classList.add('u-hidden');

            openBtn.classList.remove('u-hiddenVisually');
            closeBtn.classList.add('u-hiddenVisually');

            document.body.classList.remove('mobile-nav-open');

            closeAllAccordions();
        }

        // Toggle open
        openBtn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
            e.stopPropagation();
            openMenu();
        });

        // Toggle close
        closeBtn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
            e.stopPropagation();
            closeMenu();
        });

        // Prevent clicks inside menu from closing it
        mobileMenu.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
            e.stopPropagation();
        });

        // Close when clicking outside
        document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
            if (!mobileMenu.classList.contains('is-open')) return;

            const clickedHamburger = e.target.closest('.js-mobileHamburger, .js-mobileHamburgerClose');

            if (clickedHamburger) return;
            if (mobileMenu.contains(e.target)) return;

            closeMenu();
        });

        // Close on ESC
        document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
            if (e.key === 'Escape' && mobileMenu.classList.contains('is-open')) {
                closeMenu();
            }
        });
    });
</script>

<script type="text/rocketlazyloadscript">
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
        const megaTriggers = document.querySelectorAll('.primary-nav__link[data-menu-target]');
        const megaMenus = document.querySelectorAll('.mega-menu');
        const megaMenusContainer = document.querySelector('.mega-menus');

        const utilityItems = document.querySelectorAll('.utility-nav__item.has-dropdown');

        function closeAllMegaMenus() {
            megaMenus.forEach(function (menu) {
                menu.classList.add('u-hidden');
            });

            megaTriggers.forEach(function (trigger) {
                trigger.classList.remove('is-active');
                trigger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
            });

            if (megaMenusContainer) {
                megaMenusContainer.classList.remove('open');
            }
        }

        function closeAllUtilityDropdowns() {
            utilityItems.forEach(function (item) {
                const trigger = item.querySelector('.utility-nav__link');
                const dropdown = item.querySelector('.utility-nav__dropdown');

                item.classList.remove('is-active');

                if (trigger) {
                    trigger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
                }

                if (dropdown) {
                    dropdown.classList.add('u-hidden');
                }
            });
        }

        function closeAllMenus() {
            closeAllMegaMenus();
            closeAllUtilityDropdowns();
        }

        function openMegaMenu(trigger) {
            const targetId = trigger.getAttribute('data-menu-target');
            const targetMenu = document.getElementById(targetId);

            if (!targetMenu) return;

            closeAllMenus();

            targetMenu.classList.remove('u-hidden');
            trigger.classList.add('is-active');
            trigger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');

            if (megaMenusContainer) {
                megaMenusContainer.classList.add('open');
            }
        }

        megaTriggers.forEach(function (trigger) {
            trigger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');

            trigger.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
                event.preventDefault();
                event.stopPropagation();

                const targetId = this.getAttribute('data-menu-target');
                const targetMenu = document.getElementById(targetId);

                if (!targetMenu) return;

                const isHidden = targetMenu.classList.contains('u-hidden');

                if (isHidden) {
                    openMegaMenu(this);
                } else {
                    closeAllMegaMenus();
                }
            });
        });

        utilityItems.forEach(function (item) {
            const trigger = item.querySelector('.utility-nav__link');
            const dropdown = item.querySelector('.utility-nav__dropdown');

            if (!trigger || !dropdown) return;

            trigger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');

            trigger.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
                event.preventDefault();
                event.stopPropagation();

                const isHidden = dropdown.classList.contains('u-hidden');

                closeAllMenus();

                if (isHidden) {
                    item.classList.add('is-active');
                    trigger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
                    dropdown.classList.remove('u-hidden');
                }
            });

            dropdown.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
                event.stopPropagation();
            });
        });

        megaMenus.forEach(function (menu) {
            menu.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
                event.stopPropagation();
            });
        });

        document.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
            const clickedMegaTrigger = event.target.closest('.primary-nav__link[data-menu-target]');
            const clickedMegaMenu = event.target.closest('.mega-menu');
            const clickedUtilityItem = event.target.closest('.utility-nav__item.has-dropdown');
            const clickedUtilityDropdown = event.target.closest('.utility-nav__dropdown');

            if (
                !clickedMegaTrigger &&
                !clickedMegaMenu &&
                !clickedUtilityItem &&
                !clickedUtilityDropdown
            ) {
                closeAllMenus();
            }
        });

        document.addEventListener('keydown', function (event) {
            if (event.key === 'Escape') {
                closeAllMenus();
            }
        });

        // ---------------------------------------
        // Global Search Modal
        // ---------------------------------------

        const searchModal = document.getElementById('global-search-modal');

        if (searchModal) {

            const searchInput = searchModal.querySelector('.search-modal__input');
            const closeBtn = searchModal.querySelector('.global-search-modal__close');
            const openTriggers = document.querySelectorAll('[data-search-open]');

            function openSearch() {
                // Close other menus if needed
                if (typeof closeAllMenus === 'function') {
                    closeAllMenus();
                }

                searchModal.classList.add('is-open');
                searchModal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
                document.body.classList.add('search-open');

                if (searchInput) {
                    setTimeout(() => searchInput.focus(), 50);
                }
            }

            function closeSearch() {
                searchModal.classList.remove('is-open');
                searchModal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
                document.body.classList.remove('search-open');
            }

            // ---------------------------------------
            // Open triggers (nav button, icon, etc.)
            // ---------------------------------------
            openTriggers.forEach(function (trigger) {
                trigger.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    e.stopPropagation();

                    const isOpen = searchModal.classList.contains('is-open');

                    if (isOpen) {
                        closeSearch();
                    } else {
                        openSearch();
                    }
                });
            });

            // ---------------------------------------
            // Close button
            // ---------------------------------------
            if (closeBtn) {
                closeBtn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    closeSearch();
                });
            }

            // ---------------------------------------
            // ESC key
            // ---------------------------------------
            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Escape' && searchModal.classList.contains('is-open')) {
                    closeSearch();
                }
            });
        }
    });
</script>

            <script type="text/rocketlazyloadscript">
                (function () {

                    const disableVideoCarousel = false;
                    const useCanvas = false;

                    function initVideoCarousel() {

                        if (disableVideoCarousel) return;

                        const videoContainer = document.querySelector('.video-carousel-container');
                        const buttons = document.querySelectorAll('.video-carousel-button');

                        if (!videoContainer || !buttons.length) return;

                        if (useCanvas) {
                            videoContainer.classList.add('use-canvas');
                        }

                        // Prevent VWO from initializing this more than once
                        if (videoContainer.dataset.carouselInitialized === 'true') return;
                        videoContainer.dataset.carouselInitialized = 'true';

                        const videoItems = Array.from(videoContainer.children);
                        if (useCanvas) {
                            // Render videos through canvas
                            videoItems.forEach((item) => {
                                const video = item.querySelector('video');
                                const canvas = item.querySelector('.video-carousel-canvas');

                                if (!video || !canvas) return;

                                const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d', {
                                    alpha: false
                                });

                                canvas.width = 1;
                                canvas.height = 1;

                                ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
                                ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 1, 1);

                                let callbackId = null;

                                function requestFrame(callback) {
                                    if ('requestVideoFrameCallback' in video) {
                                        return video.requestVideoFrameCallback(callback);
                                    }

                                    return requestAnimationFrame(callback);
                                }

                                function cancelFrame(id) {
                                    if (id === null) return;

                                    if ('cancelVideoFrameCallback' in video) {
                                        video.cancelVideoFrameCallback(id);
                                    } else {
                                        cancelAnimationFrame(id);
                                    }
                                }

                                function resizeCanvas() {
                                    if (!video.videoWidth || !video.videoHeight) return;

                                    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();

                                    // Hidden slides won't have a measurable width
                                    if (!rect.width) return;

                                    const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;

                                    // Physical resolution required for the current display
                                    const desiredWidth = Math.round(rect.width * dpr);

                                    // Don't render larger than the source video
                                    const width = Math.min(
                                        desiredWidth,
                                        video.videoWidth
                                    );

                                    const height = Math.round(
                                        width * (video.videoHeight / video.videoWidth)
                                    );

                                    if (
                                        canvas.width !== width ||
                                        canvas.height !== height
                                    ) {
                                        canvas.width = width;
                                        canvas.height = height;
                                    }
                                }

                                function drawFrame() {
                                    resizeCanvas();

                                    if (canvas.width && canvas.height) {
                                        ctx.drawImage(
                                            video,
                                            0,
                                            0,
                                            canvas.width,
                                            canvas.height
                                        );
                                    }

                                    if (!video.paused && !video.ended) {
                                        callbackId = requestFrame(drawFrame);
                                    }
                                }

                                video.addEventListener('play', () => {
                                    cancelFrame(callbackId);
                                    callbackId = requestFrame(drawFrame);
                                });

                                video.addEventListener('pause', () => {
                                    cancelFrame(callbackId);
                                    callbackId = null;
                                });

                                video.addEventListener('ended', () => {
                                    cancelFrame(callbackId);
                                    callbackId = null;
                                });
                            });
                        }

                        function switchVideo(index) {

                            // Hide and reset everything
                            videoItems.forEach((item) => {
                                item.classList.add('u-hidden');

                                const video = item.querySelector('video');

                                if (video) {
                                    video.pause();
                                    video.currentTime = 0;
                                }
                            });

                            // Reset buttons
                            buttons.forEach((button) => {
                                button.classList.remove('active');
                            });

                            // Show selected video
                            const target = videoItems[index];

                            if (!target) return;

                            const video = target.querySelector('video');

                            target.classList.remove('u-hidden');

                            if (buttons[index]) {
                                buttons[index].classList.add('active');
                            }

                            // Play selected video
                            if (video) {
                                video.currentTime = 0;
                                video.play().catch(() => {});
                            }
                        }

                        // Button clicks
                        buttons.forEach((button, index) => {
                            button.addEventListener('click', () => {
                                switchVideo(index);
                            });
                        });

                        // Advance when video finishes
                        videoItems.forEach((item, index) => {
                            const video = item.querySelector('video');

                            if (!video) return;

                            video.addEventListener('ended', () => {
                                const nextIndex = (index + 1) % videoItems.length;
                                switchVideo(nextIndex);
                            });
                        });

                        // Always start on first video
                        switchVideo(0);
                    }

                    // Normal page load
                    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
                        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initVideoCarousel);
                    } else {
                        // Important for VWO — DOMContentLoaded already happened
                        initVideoCarousel();
                    }

                })();

    async function hashEmail(email) {
      const encoder = new TextEncoder();
      const data = encoder.encode(email.trim().toLowerCase());
      const hashBuffer = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', data);
      return Array.from(new Uint8Array(hashBuffer))
        .map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0'))
        .join('');
    }
